author: sproul
content: we could still increase for Gloas in a semi-backwards compatible way, right? (the chain history of Sepolia+Hoodi with the low limit enforced would be compatible with a higher limit)

author: sproul
content: even without index-inflated differences, there are a lot of possible AttestationData pairs an attacker can use in an attack (they can probably use a unique block root for each equivocating validator in the extreme)

author: jtraglia
content: Yes, it should be compatible. To be clear, we wouldn't increase the limit on the testnets, right? That _would_ be consensus breaking.

author: sproul
content:
well it's part of the preset, so the default would be to increase it

if we did a coordinated/timed release on the testnets it would be OK, as the old chain history is compatible with the new limit

author: sproul
content: but yes once nodes start producing blocks with the new limit, old nodes would lose the canonical chain (it would be a hardfork)

author: jtraglia
content: I would prefer to wait until Heze, as it would be a bit of a headache to deal with. I don't fully understand the issue that BlueIridium shared, but it doesn't seem urgent.

author: potuz
content: I don't think this matters much though. Attestations are slashable in order to guarantee accountable safety, the FFG component is what matters and not the LMD one.
